description:
Find your next business from a conversation. Venturu connects you to one of the largest online marketplaces for businesses for sale in the US, with thousands of verified listings and over a thousand brokers.

Search listings by location, price, revenue, industry, and 20+ other filters. Find brokers by city, specialty, or language. Pull up full details on any listing or broker profile, and send inquiries to sellers or brokers — all without leaving ChatGPT.

What you can do:

- Search businesses for sale by location, price range, revenue, industry, SBA eligibility, and more
- Find and compare verified business brokers
- Get detailed listing info including financials, employee count, and deal structure
- Contact sellers and brokers directly from the chat

Free to search and browse. Messaging sellers and brokers requires a free Venturu account.

defaultPrompt: Find bakery businesses for sale in Florida under $500k
